title: Digital Stories | David J. Sencer CDC Museum | CDC
content: The David J. Sencer CDC Museum is temporarily closed. Continue to check our website for further updates on when we will reopen. When the museum reopens, all visitors will need to make reservations at least a week in advance. Walk-in visits are no longer permitted. Digital Stories Print Minus Related Pages The digital stories featured below link the history of CDC to the present. Suitable for teens and adults, these stories focus on public health topics with an emphasis on core life science concepts. Marauding Microbes The Science and Impact of Viruses Throughout History More Environmental Pathogens A quick tour through some of the germs that make us sick More Public Health Success Stories How has public health helped people live happier and longer lives? More Environmental Health How does the world around us affect our well-being?
